entries.headline: USAF transports over Atlantic and North Sea reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported multiple US Air Force transport aircraft airborne over the Atlantic and North Sea, with one coded radio broadcast heard in the preceding hour.

entries.headline: Six USAF cargo jets and two coded broadcasts reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported six large US Air Force cargo aircraft airborne and two coded radio broadcasts detected in the preceding hour, describing transport activity over the country as unusually high.

entries.headline: Elevated coded traffic and two command jets reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported coded US Air Force radio broadcasts at nearly four times normal across nine global regions from the Middle East to the Asia-Pacific, with two nuclear command aircraft airborne over the United States.

entries.headline: KC-46A WINK89 spotted
entries.summary: War Watch identified a Boeing KC-46A Pegasus using callsign WINK89, hex AE5BC6 and registration 16-46021, citing a sighting by reagan0965.

entries.headline: US nuclear command aircraft and six transports reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported a US Air Force nuclear command aircraft over the continental United States and six military transport aircraft airborne across multiple regions.

entries.headline: VC-25A 92-9000 spotted without a callsign
entries.summary: War Watch identified a Boeing VC-25A with no callsign shown, hex ADFDF9 and registration 92-9000, citing a sighting by reagan0965 and a photo by Ege Şanda via Planespotters.net.

entries.headline: Five USAF transports and a nuclear command jet reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported five US Air Force transport aircraft airborne over the United States alongside a nuclear command aircraft.

entries.headline: Iranian government Avro RJ-85 IRAN08 spotted
entries.summary: War Watch identified a Government of Iran Avro RJ-85 using callsign IRAN08, hex 7324E6 and registration EP-IGF, citing a sighting by reagan0965 and a photo by Mohamadreza Zeinloo via Planespotters.net.

entries.headline: Coded USAF broadcasts reported at nearly four times normal
entries.summary: War Watch reported coded US Air Force radio broadcasts at nearly four times their usual rate across nine regions, with four broadcasts heard in the preceding hour.

entries.headline: Six USAF transports and elevated coded traffic reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported six US Air Force transport aircraft airborne over the continental United States and 11 coded radio broadcasts logged that day, including two in the preceding hour.

entries.headline: Six US cargo aircraft and one coded broadcast reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported six US military cargo aircraft airborne over the United States, above normal numbers, and one coded radio broadcast heard in the preceding hour.

entries.headline: Boeing C-32A using AF2 callsign spotted
entries.summary: War Watch identified a Boeing C-32A using callsign AF2, hex ADFEB8 and registration 98-0002, citing a sighting by reagan0965 and a photo via Planespotters.net.

entries.summary: SkyGlass posted an OFF Ground alert for an Indian military P-8 aircraft at Puttur, India. The callsign was shown as NA.

entries.headline: P-8 BFLO44 on-ground alert at Burton
entries.summary: SkyGlass posted an ON Ground alert for military P-8 aircraft BFLO44 at Burton, Australia.

entries.headline: P-8 airborne alert at Yellapur
entries.summary: SkyGlass posted an OFF Ground alert for an India-registered military P-8 aircraft at Yellapur, India. The callsign was shown as NA.

entries.headline: P-8 ASY208 on-ground alert at Darwin
entries.summary: SkyGlass posted an ON Ground alert for Australian-registered military P-8 aircraft ASY208 at Darwin, Australia.

entries.headline: E-6 airborne alert at Suisun
entries.summary: SkyGlass posted an OFF Ground alert for a US military E-6 aircraft at Suisun, California. The callsign was shown as NA.

entries.headline: P-8 BLKT23 on-ground alert at Darwin
entries.summary: SkyGlass posted an ON Ground alert for Australian-registered military P-8 aircraft BLKT23 at Darwin, Australia.

entries.headline: E-6 airborne alert at Chesapeake Ranch Estates
entries.summary: SkyGlass posted an OFF Ground alert for a US military E-6 aircraft at Chesapeake Ranch Estates, United States. The callsign was shown as NA.

entries.headline: SkyGlass shares report on AEVEX Specter attack drone
entries.summary: SkyGlass shared a Defence Blog report that AEVEX displayed its turbojet-powered Specter attack drone at AUSA.

entries.headline: SkyGlass shares report comparing Mojave and Gray Eagle UAVs
entries.summary: SkyGlass shared a Breaking Defense report comparing General Atomics’ Mojave STOL and Gray Eagle 25M unmanned aircraft.

entries.headline: SkyGlass shares report on European U740 first flight
entries.summary: SkyGlass shared a TWZ report that the European U740 variant of the XQ-58A Valkyrie completed its first flight in an Airbus-Kratos program.

entries.headline: E-3TF NATO03 on-ground alert at Gangelt
entries.summary: SkyGlass posted an ON Ground alert for Luxembourg-registered military E-3TF aircraft NATO03 at Gangelt, Germany.

entries.headline: P-8 RFR7042 airborne alert at Greenwood
entries.summary: SkyGlass posted an OFF Ground alert for UK-registered military P-8 aircraft RFR7042 at Greenwood, CA.
